**[SUGGESTION]:** Signal-terminated children are reported as exit 255, not 128+signal

`exec.ExitError.ExitCode()` returns `-1` when the child dies from a signal instead of exiting normally, so `os.Exit(-1)` surfaces as status 255. The old extensionless Bash shim conveyed the shell's 128+signal convention, and this launcher's stated contract (the R10-02 receipt: preserves the dispatched child's exit status) is status fidelity. A deadline or interrupt that signal-kills only the inner script while the launcher survives is therefore misreported. Guard the -1 case, e.g. recover the signal from `exit.ProcessState.Sys()` and exit 128+signal.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.

**[SUGGESTION]:** Assertions fail silently - no diagnostic names the broken check

Lines 28-34 use bare `[[ ]]`, `cmp` and `grep` predicates under `set -e`; on failure the script just aborts with exit 1 and no output identifying which expectation failed (exit status 47, exact stdout bytes, the stderr line, or the fail-closed 127). The repo's convention elsewhere (the `expect` helper in scripts/test/test_ci.sh) prints a named FAIL and retains command output, so a hosted failure of this new gate would require local reproduction merely to learn which invariant broke. Wrap the checks in a named expect-style helper or emit a FAIL line per assertion.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.

**[SUGGESTION]:** Retained CRLF model wrapper hard-requires a --binary-capable host jq

This control unconditionally prepends `--binary` to `$MODEL_REAL_JQ`, yet R10-01's own red evidence shows Unix jq builds - GitHub Linux runners and jq 1.6/1.7 - reject that flag. The in-repo analogue in scripts/test/test_notices.sh received a capability probe with a legacy fallback for exactly this reason, so as retained the full CRLF shell model only re-executes verbatim on hosts whose jq already accepts the Windows-only flag, limiting the reproducibility the control exists to provide. Mirror the probe/fallback here or record the required jq identity alongside the retained log.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
